body.name: tied-risk finite-support witness
body.construction: Fix \(\lambda\in(0,1)\), \(t\in(0,1]\), and \(\sigma_0^2,\sigma_1^2>0\), along rows satisfying \(\lambda_{n,\mathcal R}\to\lambda\).  Take no covariates.  Conditional on \(R=1\), let \(A\sim\operatorname{Bernoulli}(1/2)\) be independent of the potential outcomes, let the two potential outcomes be independent with \(Y(a)=\pm\sigma_a\) with probability one half, and set the observed outcome to \(Y=AY(1)+(1-A)Y(0)\).  Use \(L((x,y);\theta)=(y-\theta)^2/2\) and an independent uniform tie breaker.  Conditional on \(R=0\), set \(A=0\) on every row.  On every initial convention row with \(t_n^{\dagger}<t/2\), set \(Y(0)=Y(1)=Y=0\).  On every tail row with \(t_n^{\dagger}\geq t/2\), set \(Y(0)=Y(1)=Y=a_n^{\dagger}/\sqrt n\), with \(a_n^{\dagger}\) given by its displayed formula; in both cases the observed external outcome is \(Y=Y(0)\).  Draw the first \(n_{\mathcal R}\) records independently from the trial law and the remaining \(n_{\mathcal E}\) records independently from the external law, independently across strata.  Every external score is equal, so \(U_n(Z)=V\) and prefix \(k_n^{\dagger}\) is exactly \(V\leq t_n^{\dagger}\).  On the tail rows the amplitude equates the within-stratum variance gain \(D_n\) with the squared local bias \(B_n^2(a_n^{\dagger})^2\) plus within-stratum shift variance \(K_n^{\dagger}(a_n^{\dagger})^2/n\).
